Title 2: Prototype - Fix - Match reused documents by type key, not by name
Description:
Context: Classification: Fix. Name matching attaches wrong documents: a crew certificate on a Flag State Registry slot, one document on five vessel slots, a crane register on a lifeboat. Design: docs/plans/2026-11-13-auto-attach-existing-documents-design.md.

Build:
1. Rewrite findMatchingDocumentForRequirement in src/utils/documentMatchingHelpers.ts to match slot docTypeId to document docTypeId exactly.
2. Find the object's documents: vessel by vesselId or targetObjectId; crew by targetObjectId plus every set crew member's layer 1 and layer 2 certificates (ADR 0023); equipment by targetObjectId.
3. Only reuse a vault document that is Verified, not Expired and with expiryDate after today; a crew certificate that is Verified or Expiring with expiryDate after today.
4. Latest expiryDate wins. Slots with no docTypeId get nothing. Keep the A16 check.
5. Keep normalizeText and matchesVesselRequirement for their other callers.

Done when: a slot is only filled by a valid document of its own type for its own object.

Testing: unit tests for exact key, wrong key, expired, pending, latest expiry wins, and one case per object type; assetDocumentAutoAttachment.test.ts updated to the key rule.

Repo: MAPv2
Target: prototype
Acceptance Criteria: Matching uses docTypeId only; invalid documents are never reused; all tests pass.

Testing: store test creating a set and checking reused slots, readiness and audit events; updated E3 test.

Repo: MAPv2
Target: prototype
Acceptance Criteria: Reused slots start Verified and fulfilled with an audit event; uploads and hand links still wait for the Verifier; all tests pass.
